name: Sun Cleric: base parry exists before Divine Right (#8038)
contract: Every plate-capable class starts with the Parry passive (spell 3124, SPELL_EFFECT_PARRY) and therefore 5% parry; the Sun Cleric class grant omitted it, so the character panel read 0.00% until Divine Right 680631 added its own parry modifier. The class must grant Parry at level 1, and Divine Right must still add its 2 points on top.

steps.label: SETUP: character creation grants the Parry passive
